profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead at CallTrackingMetrics
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer, passionate about building scalable and high-performing SaaS applications. My current work involves everything from integrating Google Analytics for better data insights to enhancing user interactions with our VoIP phone. I’ve led key projects, like upgrading our Rails version and optimizing background processes with Resque, to ensure our platform is robust and efficient.

Some highlights of my career include:

- **Scalable Solutions**: Building resilient applications that scale seamlessly.
- **Data & Insights**: Creating integrations with Google and Salesforce to boost marketing capabilities.
- **User Experience**: Enhancing UI components for better interactivity and responsiveness.
- **Team Leadership**: Mentoring junior engineers and standardizing coding practices across the team.
- **Customer Focus**: Working with product managers and the Customer Experience committee to refine our features based on user feedback.

Before this, I was a Software Consultant at Solution Street, where I developed ERP software using JavaScript, debugged Visual Basic .NET code, and implemented unit tests with Jasmine.

I love tackling complex technical challenges and delivering high-quality software. Collaboration and continuous improvement are at the heart of my work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mobile Application (iOS/Android - React Native)
- Develop a React Native mobile application with TypeScript, Redux, and TanStack Query to support calls, messaging, contact tracking, and other key platform features
- Architect real-time messaging features with push notifications and cache synchronization, eliminating stale data and Elasticsearch indexing delays for instant SMS updates

Answering247 (AI Voice Agent SaaS)
- Led the architecture and development of an AI voice agent application built with Next.js and LiveKit
- Implemented RAG with Pinecone vector database for customer knowledge base lookups
- Utilized Redis streams and web sockets for real-time updates to the Activity Log UI, complete with transcriptions and AI summaries

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop a robust contact center SaaS application built in Ruby on Rails, focusing on scalability and performance
• Design, create, and maintain a seamless integration with Google Analytics 4, enhancing data insights and reporting capabilities
• Create a “universal mappings” architecture to streamline mapping sets across multiple integrations
• Build UI and billing logic for discount packs, enhancing product offerings and revenue streams
• Enhance user experience by building reactive components with vanilla JavaScript and jQuery, improving interactivity and responsiveness
• Led the upgrade of our production Rails version from 7.0 to 7.1, contributing to improved performance and stability
• Optimize asynchronous processes using Resque, a Redis-backed library for background jobs
• Resolve customer reported bugs promptly, ensuring high product quality
• Mentor and onboard junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and productive team environment
• Standardize JavaScript coding practices team-wide by implementing an ESLint commit hook, ensuring code consistency
• Demo and collaborate on new product features with current and prospective customers
• Collaborate with product managers on feature design and implementation, creating spec docs and managing Jira tickets
• Represent the engineering team in the company's Customer Experience committee, contributing to product improvements based on customer feedback

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
• Develop enterprise resource planning (ERP) software designed for large scale project-based companies using a proprietary
framework built on top of JavaScript and CanJS
• Populate UI component data and perform CRUD actions using asynchronous RESTful API calls
• Implement client side unit tests using Jasmine
• Interact with relational databases by running SQL queries in Microsoft SSMS
• Debug and fix issues on the Visual Basic .NET server side
• Handle customer support cases as they arise
• Ensure code quality and adherence to best practices by reviewing other developers’ pull requests
• Assist junior developers and help get them acquainted with the framework
• Fix bugs on a repair and returns app built in Ruby on Rails
• Conduct technical interviews for prospective Solution Street employees

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
• Improved UX and styling on a content migration project using HTML and CSS
• Ensured that the correct content was displayed across all nodes by working with Drupal CMS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed application to match language tutors with students based on interests and skill level
• Added features, fixed bugs, and worked on styling using React/Redux, Ruby on Rails, and CSS/Sass

positions.title: Production Manager / Sound Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with technical directors and backline providers to produce concerts at venues across the United States and Canada
• Produced live sound and visual components, coordinated merchandise sales

positions.title: Assistant Engineer
positions.description:
• Used Digital Performer and other audio software (plug-ins) to mix/edit studio and live recordings to provide the highest quality projects for clients
• Set up equipment for live and in-studio performances

positions.title: Keyboard & Guitar Instructor
positions.description:
• Taught private keyboard and guitar lessons for adults and children (up to 12 lessons per week) 
• Led group jam sessions and assisted with performance rehearsals
